$f=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'v2.3.0rc3_check'; $r=Join-Path $f 'v2.3.0rc3_results.txt'; $n='Garmin Running Data Normalizer.lnk'; $dl=(New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).NameSpace('shell:Downloads').Self.Path; if (-not $dl) { $dl="$HOME\Downloads" }; $dpi=(Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).AppliedDPI; $vc=Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Where-Object { $_.CurrentHorizontalResolution } | Select-Object -First 1; $light=(Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).AppsUseLightTheme; $edge=(Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Edge\BLBeacon' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).version; $web=(Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Associations\UrlAssociations\https\UserChoice' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProgId; $o=('W1 ' + (Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm') + ' / os ' + [Environment]::OSVersion.Version + ' / ps ' + $PSVersionTable.PSVersion + ' / ' + (py --version) + ' / dpi ' + $dpi + ' / screen ' + $vc.CurrentHorizontalResolution + 'x' + $vc.CurrentVerticalResolution + ' / apps-light ' + $light + ' / edge ' + $edge + ' / web ' + $web + ' / venv ' + (Test-Path "$HOME\garmin-normalizer") + ' / venv-rc ' + (Test-Path "$HOME\garmin-normalizer-rc") + ' / outputs ' + (Test-Path "$HOME\GarminRunningData") + ' / settings ' + (Test-Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\garmin-running-data-normalizer") + ' / settings-file ' + (Test-Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\garmin-running-data-normalizer\gui-settings.json") + ' / marks-file ' + (Test-Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\garmin-running-data-normalizer\gui-marks.json") + ' / desktop-icon ' + (Test-Path (Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')) $n)) + ' / start-icon ' + (Test-Path (Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Programs')) $n)) + ' / zip-in-downloads ' + (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dl 'synthetic_garmin_export_x12d.zip')) + ' / pictures-in-downloads ' + @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dl -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'garmin-*.svg' }).Count + ' / backend ' + [bool](Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'python.exe' OR Name = 'pythonw.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*garmin_running_data_normalizer*' })); Add-Content -LiteralPath $r -Value $o -Encoding ASCII; $o
